name: basic-eval-suite
description: Demonstrates the core eval check types for CLI and file testing.

tests.name: echo command succeeds
tests.description: Verify a basic shell command exits cleanly.

tests.name: echo output contains greeting
tests.description: Verify command output contains expected text.

tests.name: echo output does not contain error
tests.description: Verify command output does NOT contain error text.

tests.name: eval.json file exists
tests.description: Verify the eval config file exists on disk.

tests.name: temp file does not exist
tests.description: Verify a non-existent file is reported as missing.

tests.name: kennel.toml contains package name
tests.description: Verify a file contains expected text.

tests.name: kennel.toml does not contain forbidden text
tests.description: Verify a file does NOT contain unexpected text.

tests.name: JSON shape validation passes
tests.description: Verify a JSON file has expected keys.

tests.name: exit code is 0 for echo
tests.description: Verify a command exits with a specific code.

tests.name: deliberate failure example
tests.description: This test intentionally fails to show failure reporting.

params.command: echo 'this succeeds, so the check fails'
